title: LaPaz statement in Aviation Week on two unknown objects
summary: Jesse Michels tells of LaPaz statement in Aviation Week on two unknown objects, about 1954-08-23 at White Sands and Holloman, New Mexico, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: On August 23rd, 1954, Aviation Week and Space Technology published a statement from LaPaz,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that on August 23, 1954, an aviation trade magazine called Aviation Week and Space Technology printed a statement from Lincoln LaPaz, a scientist who studied meteors, about two unknown objects linked to White Sands and Holloman, military test sites in New Mexico. Michels ties it to the final report of a project that searched the sky for objects circling near Earth. He tells it because, if true, it would mean scientists were tracking unexplained objects around the planet at the very start of the space age.
